ideas.pitch: A web platform tailored for competitive programming teams to analyze past contest performance, track algorithmic weak points across codeforces or custom problem sets, and generate collaborative solve-order strategies for multi-PC preliminary rounds.
ideas.title: ICPC Team Strategy Visualizer and Algorithm Recommender
ideas.why_it_could_win: WCPC is inspired by the ICPC and targets competitive programmers. Building a tooling platform specifically meant to optimize ICPC team dynamics and problem-solving order directly appeals to the organizers and judges' core domain.

ideas.pitch: A specialized code editor designed for multi-PC preliminary rounds where teams of 3 can seamlessly share state, annotate problem statements together in real-time, and prevent duplicate coding efforts across distributed terminals.
ideas.title: AlgoDuet: Synchronous Multi-PC Collaborative Code Editor for ICPC Prelims
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the specific rule format of WCPC where preliminary rounds allow up to three PCs, solving a real coordination pain point for collegiate competitive programmers.

ideas.pitch: A high-performance local judging environment that uses lightweight LLM generation to automatically create edge-case test generators and stress-testers for complex algorithmic problems from incomplete problem descriptions.
ideas.title: CP-Kernel: Automated Local Judge and Test Case Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines rigorous algorithmic engineering with smart tooling, mirroring the technical depth seen in winning projects that execute difficult logic under strict time constraints.

ideas.pitch: An AST-based static analysis extension that parses candidate solutions in C++ or Python during a live contest, instantly calculating exact big-O bounds and flagging potential TLE or MLE vulnerabilities before submission.
ideas.title: ComplexityPulse: Real-Time Time and Space Complexity Estimator for Competitive Coders
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the exact failure mode every competitive programmer faces in high-pressure rounds (Time Limit Exceeded), providing immediate, highly practical utility for an audience of ICPC aspirants.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent team formation and assignment engine that analyzes individual member ratings across graph theory, dynamic programming, and data structures to recommend optimal pairing and problem distribution strategies.
ideas.title: GraphMatch: ICPC Roster Optimizer and Skill-Gap Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on the teamwork aspect heavily emphasized in the WCPC description, helping student colleges build stronger, well-balanced competitive programming squads.
